description: Exact-match exception registry for tooling/security/scan_history_secrets.py. Every entry names the category, the SHA-256 of the matched value or added line (never the value itself), and why it is not a credential. Email matches are exempted by reserved domain instead of by value. Removing an entry makes the scanner fail closed.

email_domains.callcenter.local: synthetic tenant domain used only by repository fixtures

line_exceptions.reason: fake AWS-shaped fixture ('AKIA' + 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP') written literally in tests/test_history_secret_scan.py at commit a796ab3; it is not a credential and the current tree builds the fixture at runtime instead

value_exceptions.reason: fixed synthetic test credential in scripts/role_smoke.py, used only to create accounts on a loopback-only test server
